mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT keep falling for another month, weekday trips will remain suppressed and retail visits will keep weakening, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next 4 weeks than over the last 4 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not recover from their current lows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GROCERY_PHARM below its prior two-week level signals tighter household trip consolidation and fewer discretionary errands, which then spills into weaker retail-and-recreation demand within 1 to 2 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM remains below -15 for at least one weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both weaken at the same time, mobility restrictions or voluntary avoidance reduce cross-district movement, and retail footfall falls over the next 4 weeks more than it would from either series alone.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to fall further when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are below -35 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS mobility captures warmer-weather substitution toward outdoor leisure, and some recreation spending follows into nearby commercial areas, so RETAIL_REC should improve over the next 4 weeks if PARKS rebounds from its current trough.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -10 after being below -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its last-4-week mean even after PARKS moves above -10 for at least two weekly observations.

mechanism_narrative: A near-term rebound in RESIDENTIAL from elevated levels indicates more time spent at home, which mechanically lowers out-of-home shopping and leisure trips within 1 week and pushes RETAIL_REC down.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL increases by at least 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken in the following week after a week-on-week rise in RESIDENTIAL.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC both continue to fall together, the signal is broad demand compression rather than location substitution, and retail-and-recreation mobility will remain below the prior 4-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC reverses upward despite another week of declining GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: A combined collapse in TRANSIT and PARKS marks a broad suppression of both commuting and discretionary outings, which should depress retail visits over the next 2 weeks as mobility frictions spread across trip purposes.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and PARKS both fall below -35
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after both TRANSIT and PARKS are below -35 in the same week.

mechanism_narrative: In a holiday or weekend-heavy regime, a modest rise in PARKS followed by a lagged rise in RETAIL_REC reflects leisure-to-shopping spillovers, so retail-and-recreation mobility should be higher over the next 4 weeks than over the last 4 weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below the last-4-week mean even as PARKS trends upward for four consecutive weeks.
